plain.li: Argued with {OTHER_nameDef} about the pots. I've scrubbed them three days running and I'm not doing it again tomorrow.
{OTHER_nameDef} says it was my turn to sweep. It wasn't.
After all that arguing with {OTHER_nameDef}, I swept the hall myself. Quicker.
{OTHER_nameDef} and I had words over the slop bucket. Neither of us carried it out.
Did my chores and half of {OTHER_nameDef}'s. I'll be bringing that up.

warm.li: Snapped at {OTHER_nameDef} over the dishes. I'll do them tomorrow without being asked, and we'll call it even.
{OTHER_nameDef} and I sorted out the chores in the end. I took the pots, and {OTHER_nameDef} took the floor.
Argued with {OTHER_nameDef} over the sweeping. We were both too tired to be right, and I'll say so tomorrow.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} skips chores. We all know it.

gloomy.li: The bowls pile up and it always comes down to me. Told {OTHER_nameDef} so. Didn't help.
Chores, arguments, more chores. {OTHER_nameDef} and I will be at this forever.
I did the washing and {OTHER_nameDef} didn't even notice.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} owes me three turns at the slop bucket. I'm keeping count.
{OTHER_nameDef} avoids the unpleasant work. I've started assigning it to {OTHER_objective} in my head.
Chore dispute with {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll raise it with the council if it continues.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} kept me up again. I lay there till the small hours, staring at the ceiling.
Woke three times in the night because of {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll be asleep in my soup at this rate.
Moved my pillow to the far end of the bed to get away from {OTHER_nameDef}'s noise. It didn't help.
{OTHER_nameDef} has no idea how loud {OTHER_pronoun} is at night.
Lay awake listening to {OTHER_nameDef} and counting. I got into the hundreds.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef}. Every night. I need a room of my own.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} had me up before the birds, so I got first pick at breakfast!
Lay awake working out what {OTHER_nameDef}'s racket sounds like. A goat in a cupboard, I've decided.

gloomy.li: Another night of {OTHER_nameDef} and the noise. I don't remember what real sleep feels like.
{OTHER_nameDef} was fresh as anything at breakfast. I could barely hold my spoon.
Woke at every sound {OTHER_nameDef} made. I'm too tired to be angry.

plain.li: Heard {OTHER_nameDef} talking about me. I told {OTHER_objective} I'd heard.
{OTHER_nameDef} told the others something I'd said in confidence. I won't make that mistake twice.
Found out what {OTHER_nameDef} has been saying about me at supper. Not much of it was true.
{OTHER_nameDef} went quiet when I came in, so I know what the talk was about.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} said something about me I wasn't meant to hear. Maybe {OTHER_pronoun} had a bad day. It still stung.
I'm going to talk to {OTHER_nameDef} about what {OTHER_pronoun} said. Calmly, I hope.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} talks too much. Mostly about me.

cold.li: Noted what {OTHER_nameDef} said behind my back. I'll remember it the next time {OTHER_pronoun} needs a favor.
{OTHER_nameDef} repeats things. I'll make sure what {OTHER_pronoun} hears from me next is worth repeating.

plain.li: Asked {OTHER_nameDef} for my knife back. Third time. Tomorrow, {OTHER_pronoun} said.
Saw my good gloves on {OTHER_nameDef}'s hands today. I lent them out last week.
{OTHER_nameDef} still has my needle. I've been mending with a thorn.
Found my spare blanket on {OTHER_nameDef}'s bed. {OTHER_nameDef} said {OTHER_pronoun} thought it was spare.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} still has my comb, so I've been doing my hair with my fingers. It looks about the same!
{OTHER_nameDef} has my cup, so I've been drinking out of a bowl. Holds more.

gloomy.li: Lent {OTHER_nameDef} my blanket on a cold night. Haven't seen it since, and the nights haven't gotten any warmer.
Lent {OTHER_nameDef} my good hat. I've stopped expecting it back.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has had my whetstone for a week. I've stopped lending {OTHER_objective} things.
Everything I've lent {OTHER_nameDef} came back late or not at all. No more.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} walked right past me today. Not a word.
Said good morning to {OTHER_nameDef} and got a grunt back.
{OTHER_nameDef} sat at the far end of the table again tonight.
I asked {OTHER_nameDef} to pass the bread, and {OTHER_pronoun} handed it to someone else to pass to me.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is still cross with me. I saved {OTHER_objective} a seat at supper anyway.
I don't know what I did to {OTHER_nameDef}, but I'd like to fix it.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} isn't talking to me. Suits me.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} won't look at me. I keep going over what I said.
{OTHER_nameDef} looks straight through me. It's worse than shouting.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made another crack about my singing. I'm not going to stop singing.
The others laughed at {OTHER_nameDef}'s joke. I didn't. It was about me.
[teen] {OTHER_nameDef} keeps calling me that name. I hate it.
{OTHER_nameDef} told the story about me and the river again. The others laughed again.
{OTHER_nameDef} copied the way I walk when {OTHER_pronoun} thought I wasn't looking.
[teen] {OTHER_nameDef} made fun of my voice cracking. I didn't say anything back, and I wish I had.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} teased me again today. I don't think {OTHER_pronoun} knows it lands harder than {OTHER_pronoun} means it to.
{OTHER_nameDef} doesn't mean anything by it. I'm going to tell {OTHER_objective} it hurts anyway.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} thinks {OTHER_pronoun}'s funny. I've started a list.
{OTHER_nameDef} enjoys making me the joke. I'll find out what {OTHER_pronoun} is sensitive about.
